design: within-cohort; all seven test MRIs contribute to the template

registration.coordinate_convention: ITK LPS physical millimetres; convert RAS explicitly
registration.scope: template construction only; transforms retained for provenance, never applied to estimates or ground truth

coregistration.procedure: same rigid fiducial initialization and trimmed ICP in both arms

sensor_policy: recorded participant geometry embedded in native forwards; released electrode TSV only for provenance audit
channels: identical frozen reference-based nominal montage, bad-channel replacement and actual ordered channels in both arms
preprocessing: reuse frozen no-warp engine; identical epoch data, average-reference scope, baseline and covariance intervals
peak_rule: known_stimulation_hemisphere_original; identical frozen rule for both arms; label use of known hemisphere
reuse_policy: deny unless per-job fingerprints and rigid alignment QA match; anatomical validation is not required for diagnostic distances
primary_difference: average_seven_diagnostic_distance_mm minus fsaverage_diagnostic_distance_mm; paired only when both PASS and protocols match
